import { Cron } from '@nestjs/schedule';

export class TwoCronsTask {
  constructor(private readonly jobs: any, private readonly prisma: any) {}

  @Cron('0 1 * * *')
  async first(): Promise<void> {
    await this.jobs.enqueue('housekeeping.first');
  }

  @Cron('0 2 * * *')
  async second(): Promise<void> {
    await this.prisma.$executeRaw`DELETE FROM sessions`;
  }
}
